name: positioning-index
description: A longitudinal tracker of how B2B SaaS companies position themselves, and how that positioning drifts over time.
author: Ruslan Shogenov

scripts.db:seed: node scripts/build-seed-sql.js > .seed.generated.sql && wrangler d1 execute positioning_index --remote --file=./.seed.generated.sql
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/build-seed-sql.js > .seed.generated.sql && wrangler d1 execute positioning_index --local --file=./.seed.generated.sql
